question: Does a new Meituan LongCat account receive a one-time free token grant, and under what identity check?
why: The FAQ says promotional credits are consumed before the paid balance but not how an account obtains one. A third-party issue report states a one-time 10M-token grant behind identity verification. The login-gated usage page longcat.chat/platform/usage returned a DNS-check refusal from the reader.
